/* Function Prototypes */

void displaytable()
{
    int i;
    printf("\n=====================================================================");
    printf("\nNo\tWebsite\t\t\tIP Address\t\tMAC Address");
    printf("\n=====================================================================");
    for(i = 0; i < MAX; i++)
    {
        printf("\n%d\t%-22s %-16s %s", i + 1, web[i].url, web[i].ip, web[i].mac);
    }
    printf("\n=====================================================================\n");
}
int search(char url[])
{
    int i;
    for(i = 0; i < MAX; i++)
    {
        if(strcmp(url, web[i].url) == 0)
            return i;
    }
    return -1;
}
/* Reads the raw stuffed bitstream text directly into the stuffeddata array */
void readstuffedfile()
{
    FILE *fp;
    char filename[100];
    char ch;
    int i = 0;
    printf("Enter Stuffed Input File Name (e.g. stuffed.txt): ");
    scanf("%s", filename);
    fp = fopen(filename, "r");
    if(fp == NULL)
    {
        printf("\nFile Not Found.");
        exit(0);
    }
    while((ch = fgetc(fp)) != EOF)
    {
        // Parse and safely capture only active bit states
        if(ch == '0' || ch == '1')
        {
            if(i < 17999)
            {
                stuffeddata[i] = ch;
                i++;
            }
        }
    }
    stuffeddata[i] = '\0';
    fclose(fp);
}
/*====================== BIT DE-STUFFING (YOUR LOGIC) ======================*/
void bitdestuffing()
{
    int i = 0, j = 0;
    int count = 0;
    FILE *fp;
    // Evaluates your loop rule block while saving index locations safely
    while(stuffeddata[i] != '\0')
    {
        destuffeddata[j] = stuffeddata[i];
        if(stuffeddata[i] == '1')
            count++;
        else
            count = 0;
        if(count == 5)
        {
            i++;
            if(stuffeddata[i] == '0')
            {
                i++;
            }
            count = 0;
            j++;   // Fixed: Increments write tracker to preserve the 5th '1'
            continue;
        }
        i++;
        j++;
    }
    destuffeddata[j] = '\0';
    printf("\n\n====================================================");
    printf("\n               BIT DESTUFFING");
    printf("\n====================================================");
    printf("\n\nReceived Stuffed Data");
    printf("\n%s", stuffeddata);
    printf("\n\nAfter Bit Destuffing");
    printf("\n%s", destuffeddata);
    printf("\n\nTransmission Status : SUCCESS");
    printf("\n\n================ DESTUFFED FRAME =================");
    printf("\n\nFlag");
    printf("\n01111110");
    printf("\n\nSource MAC");
    printf("\n%s", web[src].mac);
    printf("\n\nDestination MAC");
    printf("\n%s", web[des].mac);
    printf("\n\nDestuffed Data");
    printf("\n%s", destuffeddata);
    printf("\n\nTrailer");
    printf("\n0000000000000000");
    printf("\n\nFlag");
    printf("\n01111110");
    fp = fopen("destuffed.txt", "w");
    if(fp != NULL)
    {
        fprintf(fp, "=============== BIT DESTUFFING ===============\n\n");
        fprintf(fp, "Received Stuffed Data\n");
        fprintf(fp, "%s\n\n", stuffeddata);
        fprintf(fp, "After Bit Destuffing\n");
        fprintf(fp, "%s\n\n", destuffeddata);
        fprintf(fp, "Transmission Status : SUCCESS\n\n");
        fprintf(fp, "Source MAC : %s\n", web[src].mac);
        fprintf(fp, "Destination MAC : %s\n\n", web[des].mac);
        fprintf(fp, "Destuffed Data\n%s\n\n", destuffeddata);
        fprintf(fp, "Trailer\n0000000000000000\n\n");
        fprintf(fp, "Flag\n01111110\n");

        fclose(fp);
    }
    printf("\n\nOutput Written to destuffed.txt\n");
}
/*====================== MAIN FUNCTION ======================*/
int main()
{
    char sourceurl[50];
    char destinationurl[50];
    printf("\n\n=====================================================================");
    printf("\n                     RECEIVER DATA LINK SIMULATOR");
    printf("\n=====================================================================");
    displaytable();
    printf("\nEnter Source Website: ");
    scanf("%s", sourceurl);
    src = search(sourceurl);
    if(src == -1)
    {
        printf("\nSource Website Not Found.");
        return 0;
    }
    printf("\nEnter Destination Website: ");
    scanf("%s", destinationurl);
    des = search(destinationurl);
    if(des == -1)
    {
        printf("\nDestination Website Not Found.");
        return 0;
    }
    // Directly imports your output text file configuration
    readstuffedfile();
    printf("\n\n=====================================================================");
    printf("\n                      RECEIVER PROCESSING STARTED");
    printf("\n=====================================================================");
    bitdestuffing();
    return 0;
}
